title: FDA's rare disease framework faces its first real test in Capricor’s DMD drug
snippet: Last month, the FDA committed to designing a "fit-for-purpose" framework for regulating rare disease therapies based on patient need and realistically attainable evidence. With the upcoming decision for Capricor’s Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy deramiocel, this paradigm faces its first key test.

title: Coherus cuts 30% of staffers, Gyre makes post-acquisition layoffs
snippet: Coherus is narrowing its pipeline projects while Gyre reorganizes after an acquisition, with both biotechs conducting workforce reductions.

title: BIO pitches US plan to beat China in biotech ‘space race’
snippet: The seven proposals in the Bio Advance plan include easing clinical trial starts, boosting manufacturing and establishing a new White House office to coordinate the government’s biotech policy.

title: Beam preps FDA run for industry-first base-edited therapy after pivotal sickle cell success
snippet: Beam Therapeutics' risto-cel provided at least 12 consecutive months of freedom from severe pain crises for patients with sickle cell disease in a mid-stage trial, setting the stage for an FDA application as early as this year.

title: Bayer wins first-in-class FDA nod for blood thinner, setting stage for BMS-J&J rival
snippet: Bayer’s Sunharbo has secured the first FDA approval of its class, establishing a regulatory pathway for other factor XIa inhibitors, such as Bristol Myers Squibb and Johnson and Johnson’s milvexian.

title: Delix raises $100M to advance at-home psychedelic without hallucinogenic effects
snippet: The series C raise, co-led by Johnson & Johnson’s venture capital arm, will help Delix Therapeutics push its novel psychedelic asset into mid-stage development for major depressive disorder.

title: Altimmune gears up for FDA meeting on pivotal Phase 3 trial in alcohol use disorder
snippet: Having linked its glucagon/GLP-1 candidate to a significant reduction in heavy drinking days, Altimmune is preparing to speak to the FDA in December about the design of a Phase 3 program.

title: BioSpace 2027 Best Places to Work shines light on most admired employers
snippet: The list honors 50 life sciences employers of choice. Employees at SERB Pharmaceuticals and CSL Behring share why their companies stand out.
